name: Lions
overview: Scripture portrays lions as powerful and fearless creatures, symbolizing strength and boldness, as seen in Proverbs where the righteous are described as being bold as a lion and the lion is called the strongest among beasts. Lions depend on God for their provision, with young lions seeking their meat from Him and those who seek the LORD promised to lack no good thing. The imagery of a roaring lion also represents authority and divine protection, illustrated in Isaiah where the LORD is likened to a lion who will fearlessly defend His people.
